title: VKaryo: multi-omics virtual karyotyping from RNA-seq and whole-exome sequencing
description: Snakemake workflow integrating paired RNA-seq and whole-exome sequencing to detect gene fusions, structural variants, copy number changes and point mutations in one coordinated run and reconcile them into a single virtual karyotype. The detection steps do not depend on the disease under analysis; the classification layer -- driver panel, WHO-HAEM5/ICC entity assignment and risk stratification -- is specific to haematological neoplasms.
